meaning.elevation: Terrain elevation in metres, sampled from the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM.
meaning.slope: Terrain slope in degrees, derived from the DEM.
meaning.aspect: Terrain aspect in degrees clockwise from north, derived from the DEM.
meaning.roughness: Local terrain roughness, derived from the DEM.
meaning.tpi: Topographic Position Index, derived from the DEM.
meaning.land_cover_class: DERIVED PROXY (not an observed land-cover product): elevation-binned class 1 = tree cover / dense forest (<3000 m), 2 = shrubland / alpine scrub (3000-4200 m), 3 = bare rock / sparse vegetation / snow (>4200 m).
meaning.rain_1d: Precipitation total on day T-1 in mm (antecedent, no future leakage).
meaning.rain_3d: Cumulative precipitation over T-3..T-1 in mm.
meaning.rain_7d: Cumulative precipitation over T-7..T-1 in mm.
meaning.antecedent_rain_14d: Cumulative precipitation over T-14..T-1 in mm.
meaning.rain_intensity_max_3d: Maximum single-day precipitation over T-3..T-1 in mm/day.

note: Captured from the exact feature matrix used to fit the persisted model. Inference must supply these features in this order.
